changes.title: Families desperately search for loved ones swept away in Nepal floods
changes.summary: Authorities in Nepal continued mass burials after catastrophic floods roared down high mountain valleys in a vast torrent of destruction. The death toll is now over 1,000 people, with thousands still missing. Across the border in China, which has been less transparent, officials report just 16 deaths, but nearly 550 mi.

changes.title: China dissents as Bessent says 19 finance ministers agree to address 'cheap exports'
changes.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Tuesday that 19 of the members of the G20 agreed to address streams of "cheap exports" that cause global economic imbalances, but China dissented.

changes.title: China Censors and Punishes to Shape Narrative on Floods in Tibet, a Contrast to Nepal
changes.summary: While journalists can report freely on grief and anger in Nepal, China’s official media have presented a sanitized disaster aftermath in Tibet.

changes.title: Hindu pilgrims, on arduous trek, among Nepal's missing
changes.summary: Among the hundreds still missing on Nepal's border with China are Hindus from India and beyond, participating in a journey of devotion to a sacred mountain (Image credit: Rajesh Kumar Singh).

changes.title: Trump's plan for economic D-day for Iran has one big hole: China
changes.summary: The Trump administration says it's asking countries to voluntarily cut off business with Iran to squeeze its economy further. But the most critical country — China — already says it won't cooperate.
